crystal_phase.Pt/Ni-CeO2: face-centered cubic fluorite structure of CeO2
crystal_phase.Pt/CeO2: face-centered cubic fluorite structure of CeO2
crystal_phase.Pt-Ni/CeO2: face-centered cubic fluorite structure of CeO2

Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of all samples in Fig. 1a could be indexed to the face-centered cubic fluorite structure of CeO2, and no peaks of Ni-related species and Pt species were observed. However, the peak of (111) facet exhibited an obvious difference. As shown in Fig. 1b, Pt/CeO2 and Pt-Ni/CeO2 samples exhibited the similar (111) peak values with the CeO2 sample, while the peak of (111) facet in Ni-CeO2 and Pt/Ni-CeO2 samples was shifted to a slightly high 2θ value, indicating that Ni was successfully doped into the ceria lattice structure. The HRTEM image of Pt/Ni-CeO2 in Fig. 2c also revealed the (111) and (220) facet of CeO2.
